title: Seismic design requirements for masonry.
officialText:
Masonry structures and components shall comply with the requirements in
Section 1.17 of TMS 402/ACI 530/ASCE 5 depending on the structure’s seismic design category as determined in Section 1613
of this code. All masonry walls, unless isolated on three edges from in-plane motion of the basic structural systems, shall be
considered to be part of the seismic-force-resisting system.
